title: Behavioral interviews: turn a project into a clear evidence-based story
summary: Prepare an honest project story that explains your contribution, trade-offs, evidence and learning without inventing impact.

title: Cache-aside: latency, invalidation and stale reads
summary: Walk through a cache miss and a concurrent update, then choose TTL, failure behavior and stampede protection.

title: Database indexes: choose for the query, measure the cost
summary: Design a composite index for a real query and reason about ordering, selectivity, write amplification and execution plans.

title: HTTP retries and idempotency: recover without repeating a purchase
summary: Reason about a timeout after a server commit, classify retryable failures, and design a bounded idempotency-key contract.

title: JavaScript event loop: tasks, microtasks and a responsive page
summary: Predict promise and timer ordering, explain why async does not make CPU work parallel, and split expensive UI work safely.

title: OOP design: composition and a small notification boundary
summary: Separate a business action from message delivery using a small interface, then test behavior without a deep class hierarchy.

title: Processes and threads: shared memory changes the failure model
summary: Compare isolation and shared memory, trace a race condition, and explain why an atomic-looking operation can still lose updates.

title: Sliding windows: reason about a moving interval
summary: Use an invariant to find the longest substring without repeated characters, then explain why the pointers move only forward.
